meta.source: ELEO brand review, Sep 2026: direction A Ember, palette Stone + Amber

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels and the app frame.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, nav, tables and the default plot ground.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Hover fill, selected table row, current nav item.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and dark bands. Text on it: ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, values, headings, image plane and focus ring, on ground, surface, surface-alt and accent.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, units, plot titles meta, tick labels, on ground, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled text and non-text marks only (axis ticks, placeholder icons). Below 4.5:1: never for readable text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card borders, table rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, segmented controls), 3:1 or more on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one warm light: primary action fill, current-tab marker, the point in the ELEO wordmark. Never in plots.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text: links and the active segmented label, 4.5:1 or more on surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status only, with an icon and a word (Converged, Passed). Not a plot color.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status only, with an icon and a word. Darker than accent so a warning never reads as a button.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and the stale-result badge.

tokens.name: glass-crown
tokens.usage: Fill of low-index (crown) lens elements in 2D and 3D drawings.

tokens.name: glass-flint
tokens.usage: Fill of high-index (flint) lens elements; darker than crown so cemented pairs read as two parts.

tokens.name: glass-band-hi
tokens.usage: Lightest end of the per-glass fill band (oklch L .66-.93 light, .26-.52 dark; hue 225-275; chroma .10 or less). Per-glass fills mix between this and glass-band-lo.

tokens.name: glass-band-lo
tokens.usage: Darkest end of the per-glass fill band; see glass-band-hi.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Lens surfaces and rims, 1.25px, crisp. 5:1 or more on surface.

tokens.name: mech
tokens.usage: Mechanical parts (cells, spacers, housings) in 2D and 3D drawings.

tokens.name: mech-edge
tokens.usage: Edges of mechanical parts.

tokens.name: plot-grid
tokens.usage: Plot gridlines, spot-diagram boxes and crosshairs.

tokens.name: plot-frame
tokens.usage: Plot card border.

tokens.name: plot-axis
tokens.usage: Zero lines and the optical axis (dashed). 3:1 or more on surface.

tokens.name: field-1
tokens.usage: Index color 1 for fields or wavelengths (the plot says which). 3:1 or more on surface in both themes. Index 9 reuses it with a hollow marker.

tokens.name: field-2
tokens.usage: Index color 2 for fields or wavelengths (the plot says which). 3:1 or more on surface in both themes. Index 10 reuses it with a hollow marker.

tokens.name: field-5
tokens.usage: Index color 5 for fields or wavelengths (the plot says which). 3:1 or more on surface in both themes. Index 13 reuses it with a hollow marker.

tokens.name: field-6
tokens.usage: Index color 6 for fields or wavelengths (the plot says which). 3:1 or more on surface in both themes. Index 14 reuses it with a hollow marker.

tokens.name: field-7
tokens.usage: Index color 7 for fields or wavelengths (the plot says which). 3:1 or more on surface in both themes. Index 15 reuses it with a hollow marker.

tokens.name: field-8

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website hero and section openers. One per view.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles in documents and settings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Focus on the problem, not the tool.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Default UI text: buttons, nav, table text, inputs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, metric names, column heads, in ink-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes and group labels in nav (uppercase, +0.06em).

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Key values in a metric strip. Unit in label size, ink-muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Table values, inputs with numbers, prescriptions. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Plot meta, tick labels, legends, statistics under plots.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; legend key gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between plot header items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between plot cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Website section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, legend swatches, spot-diagram boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, plot cards, metric strips, tables.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App frame, floating panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and pills.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating panels, menus and dialogs only. Cards and plots stay flat.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Gridlines, optical axis, reference circles.

tokens.name: stroke-ray
tokens.usage: Rays in 2D and 3D drawings.

tokens.name: stroke-edge
tokens.usage: Lens surfaces, rims, scale bars.

tokens.name: stroke-curve
tokens.usage: Data curves (ray fans, MTF, field curves) and the image plane.

tokens.name: dash-chief
tokens.usage: Chief ray in layouts.

tokens.name: dash-sagittal
tokens.usage: Sagittal curves (T is solid).

tokens.name: dash-axis
tokens.usage: Optical axis.

tokens.name: dash-reference
tokens.usage: Reference curves: diffraction limit, ideal, nominal.

tokens.name: marker-hollow
tokens.usage: Radius of the hollow marker that marks index 9 to 16.

tokens.name: marker-spot
tokens.usage: Radius of a spot-diagram dot.

tokens.name: marker-focus
tokens.usage: Radius of an image-point dot.
